seo.title: Cartback: automatic texts for abandoned carts
seo.description: When a shopper leaves their cart, Cartback sends a short text on its own, and you pay only for the texts you send. Coming soon: join the early access list.

hero.title: A text for every abandoned cart
hero.subtitle: When a shopper leaves without paying, Cartback sends them a short text. No subscription; you buy a pack of texts and use them as you go.

benefits.title: Texts when a cart is abandoned
benefits.text: If a shopper leaves before paying, a short text goes out after the delay you choose, with a link back to their cart.

benefits.title: Pay only for texts you send

statement.text: A shopper puts the product in the cart and then *drops off at checkout*. Most stores never notice. {name} sends the person who left a short reminder. *You pay only for the texts that go out.*

faq.a: It's in development. Leave your email and we'll tell you the day it's out.

faq.q: Which store platforms will it work with?
faq.a: First targets are Shopify and WooCommerce. Other platforms will be assessed before launch.

faq.q: Is it allowed to text shoppers?
faq.a: Marketing texts need the shopper's consent, and rules differ by country. {name} is designed not to text numbers without consent; the store owner's responsibilities will be spelled out before launch.
There is no subscription. When you buy a pack, the texts left show in the dashboard, and you can stop any time.
